weather_report:
Subiaco wakes under a pewter sky, the light soft and a little sullen. Clouds are thickening, with light showers likely late in the morning and rain settling in more firmly through the early afternoon. Sunshine will be scarce, arriving only in brief, watery glimmers if the ceiling breaks; the UV should stay muted by the cloud and rain. The air is cool and clean, the edges of things slightly blurred, and streets soon to take on that mirror-bright sheen that makes colors look deeper.

Dress in layers with a light waterproof on top, shoes that won’t mind a puddle, and an umbrella you can forget about until needed. Use the morning to run simple errands before the heavier bursts, then let the afternoon turn inward: a quiet table by a cafe window, a deliberate browse at the library, or tidying the week with a pen while the rain keeps time on the awnings. If you wander, make it an unhurried loop under verandas and trees, following the rhythm of the showers rather than fighting them.
